name: Rezan
source: Apparently, he is a wandering warrior traveling through various lands to hone his martial arts skills. He gets caught up in an incident at the Youd Magic Academy, which he had visited in order to become a magic swordsman. He is cheesy, perverted, overconfident, and frivolous. When it comes to women, he is completely soft and indulgent.
